# The Library of Alexandria's slots (docs/ALEXANDRIA.md).
# One line per base slot: its number, its shorthand, its place in the
# Alexandria classification, the block entry it names, and its state.
# Append only: a slot is never renumbered, reused or deleted. A slot whose
# entry is withdrawn stays, marked "retired", so every program that names it
# gets a refusal, never another block. Slots 1..0xFFFF are the base;
# community addenda are never written here.
# A shorthand is "<namespace>.<name>", written "@<namespace>.<name>": lower
# case, digits and "_", at most 31 bytes. A place is "CCC.II": a class
# (hundreds), division (tens) and section (units), then a two-digit item.
# The namespace fixes the class:
#   100 mem      memory and allocation
#   200 crypto   cryptography and integrity
#   300 drv      devices and buses
#   400 logic    logic and evidence
#   500 num      numbers and arithmetic
#   600 fin prob strat   money, chance and decisions
#   700 wire     wire formats and protocols
#   800 text     text and languages
#   900 time swarm       time and coordination
# Every slot in one division (the first two digits) is packed into that
# division's booklet.
# tools/alexandria/build_index.py --assign BLOCK NAMESPACE SECTION appends
# a line for every entry of BLOCK (or one BLOCK.ENTRY) that has none;
# --check fails when one is missing. A shared block's shorthand is its
# entry's name (num.gcd); an app's carries the app (num.banker_total),
# since apps use local words. "--assign APP auto auto" puts an app's
# entries on the app shelf: truths in logic 490-499, numbers in num
# 590-599. The build server does that for every new app.
# slot
